item.dc:creator: Quanwei Xing Kai Deng Yibing Xiong Jiabo Xu Haofeng Xie Jinhui Liu Xiangyun Hu a School of Remote Sensing and Information Engineering, Wuhan University, Wuhan, Chinab School of Artificial Intelligence and Automation, Wuhan University of Science and Technology, Wuhan, ChinaQuanwei Xing is a PhD candidate at the School of Remote Sensing and Information Engineering, Wuhan University. Research interests include land-use change simulation and spatial allocation optimization, territorial spatial planning, and spatiotemporal information analysis and modelling.Kai Deng received a PhD in photogrammetry and remote sensing from Wuhan University. Research interests include remote sensing image change detection, visual foundation models, and remote sensing image synthesis.Yibing Xiong received a PhD in photogrammetry and remote sensing from Wuhan University. Research interests include remote sensing image interpretation, training-sample refinement, and fine-grained semantic segmentation.Jiabo Xu received a PhD in photogrammetry and remote sensing from Wuhan University. Research interests include 3D point cloud processing, airborne laser scanning, and 3D forest modeling.Haofeng Xie is a PhD candidate at the School of Remote Sensing and Information Engineering, Wuhan University. Research interests include high-definition map construction from remote sensing imagery, vectorized road mapping, and map quality assessment.Jinhui Liu is a PhD candidate at the School of Remote Sensing and Information Engineering, Wuhan University. Research interests include roof vegetation mapping, multimodal remote sensing, and domain adaptation for semantic segmentation.Xiangyun Hu is a professor at the School of Remote Sensing and Information Engineering, Wuhan University, where he received a PhD in photogrammetry and remote sensing in 2001. His research focuses on artificial intelligence and automated interpretation of remote sensing imagery.
